notes: The held abstract prints diarrhoea percentages but no per-arm event counts; served events 5 and 4 cannot be extracted without calculation and are therefore null. Totals 41 and 46 match the served totals and are described as received treatment, hence SAFETY_TREATED; the abstract does not explicitly identify them as randomised or analysed denominators. August-October 2009 is a recruitment period, and mean diarrhoea duration is not an assessment window. NOT_IN_PACKET: per-arm event counts and follow-up/assessment window.
